gen-instrument-serif-switzer: Instrument Serif builds fat bars and fine threads over Switzer. Switzer then holds tubular wire letters, c tips apart, under that rivet-clustered heading on the sheet.
gen-instrument-serif-work-sans: Fat bars and fine threads mark Instrument Serif over Work Sans. Work Sans then holds unvarying joins under that rivet-clustered heading, a plain sans on the sheet.
gen-inter-fs-erode: Open curves with no brush swell mark Inter over Erode on the heading. Hairline-sturdy serif copy against that unpulsed heading is what stands out in the classic serif.
gen-merriweather-fs-asap: Merriweather holds a g with lightly thinned links over Asap. And Asap then holds open-arc c forms, a sans-serif whose body height nearly matches the capitals.
gen-merriweather-fs-fira-sans: Dignified Merriweather holds a g with lightly thinned links over Fira Sans on the heading. Fira Sans then holds wide-open s-curves, no calligraphic swelling under that sturdy heading.
gen-merriweather-fs-supreme: Sturdy Merriweather holds a g with lightly thinned links over Supreme. Supreme then holds a heavy mid-strip of letters, held open, under that faintly modulated heading.
gen-merriweather-manrope: Manrope reads with bright gaps at every curved mouth under Merriweather. Light heading diagonals against tails matching the stems is what stands out on the sheet.
gen-merriweather-satoshi: Satoshi reads with a soaring x-height under Merriweather, every stroke cut to one measure. Running copy in that plain sans stays easy through a full column.
gen-merriweather-switzer: A g with lightly thinned links marks Merriweather over Switzer. Switzer then holds tubular wire letters under that tempered heading, a plain sans on the sheet.
gen-merriweather-work-sans: Sturdy bowls on a short case-step mark Merriweather over Work Sans. The two feel like a tempered serif against a constant-wall o, a plain sans on the sheet.
gen-mulish-fs-erode: Erode opens the g and a under Mulish, rope-coiled lowercase with no thick-and-thin shift. And unswollen heading downstrokes against that light serif modulation is the spark.
gen-nixie-one-inter: Inter reads as a tube-like sans, hollow-reed counters under Nixie One. Inter then holds those counters under Nixie One's constant stroke and open-gapped curves on the sheet.
gen-nixie-one-poppins: Poppins reads as modern sans-serif, rope-loose curves under Nixie One. And Poppins likes a modest size so those unknotted curves stay easy through running copy on the sheet.
gen-noto-serif-archivo: Noto Serif holds modest weight shifts in rounded lowercase over Archivo. Archivo then holds outward-opening curves through a full column under that literary heading on the sheet.
gen-noto-serif-fs-epilogue: Modest weight shifts in rounded lowercase mark Noto Serif over Epilogue. Epilogue likes a modest size so those unclamped curves stay easy through running copy on the sheet.
